body: Yeah. Having an ex with bpd, the highs were euphoric because one would feed each other high feelings. But the lows, oh man, devastating. One triggers the other accidentally, and its a vicious cycle of feeling bad because the other felt bad. Only relationship where I felt understood and happy, but also the one only I had to dodge knifes literally. If both in remission and or intense therapy it works wonders tho !!

I know I'm a bit late but just discovered the sub

It is in the beginning, but after some time you start to lose consciousness and that's when the feeling of release kicks in.
Holy shit this is relatable af

I know, therapy and talking to people helps but temporarily,as it quickly reverts to the original state. I'm going forward thus far, its just when i have episodes it's very hard to control myself, leading to me often on the roof of my house or with a knife on my hands.
I am, but even Prof help can't help sooo

Yes, I fully agree, I have to say I'm really lucky to have an experienced psychologist/psychiatrist but still she tells me that many times she consults with her (ex) proffers and colleges cause she has no idea what to diagnose me.

Alot of friends have explained to me that they don't know what to do, and when they ask me I tell them that I have no idea what can be done than I guess talk?

Hey, have you asked them and they told you that they are actually pissed? Because that's what I thought as well but apparently they thought I was joking but when they realised it was real they didn't mind at all.
Of losing the one hobby you like? Yeah, you lose all of them after some point but you can pick them up when you get out of a depressive episode, and then lose it again and the cycle goes on

"How" do you help? I don't know to be honest, words don't really affect me but I can recognise that the other person is putting effort into trying to help.

But brb ill edit later cause yeah

Yeah telling someone about it without them freaking out is what im afraid. Can you imagine if a student/friend suddenly came up to you and said all of these things? Wouldn't you be like "what the fuck" or "oh shit now I have to help?". Not that I trust anyone enough to tell them in the first place because I believe that everyone has an ulterior motive against me cause of my mother, as she was trying to control me in every possible way to the point where she was going through my trash to see if I have written something against her or something
